answer: Exit from the agent economy runs through a six-epoch unstaking cooldown. Each identity locks 80 credits in a marble ledger, completes one paid voyage, then waits six epochs, during which a challenger may prove fraud and burn the whole stake. The thousandth fake still posts its own fresh 80, so 1,000 fakes tie up 80,000 for six epochs, each stake confined to a separate knoll with no pooling. An honest agent posts 80 once and waits out a single cooldown, while a rented stake fails because the penalty follows the signing key, not the funder.
